name: What are the typical costs associated with buying a home as a first-time buyer?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with buying a home as a first-time buyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond the down payment, first-time home buyers face costs such as closing costs, appraisal fees, inspection fees, and initial escrow deposits for property taxes and insurance. Closing costs alone can typically range from 2% to 5% of the loan amount. Understanding these upfront expenses is crucial for budgeting. A common practical tradeoff is deciding whether to roll closing costs into the loan, increasing your monthly payment, or paying them out-of-pocket, which reduces the loan amount but requires more cash up front.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical costs include down payment, closing costs, appraisal and inspection fees, and initial escrow deposits for taxes and insurance.
